verdict.rationale: Angular provides components written in TypeScript/JavaScript with HTML templates and binding syntax, and community users confirm reusable, encapsulated components; one report notes templates can be stored as strings inside the component. Some users point to non-standard template syntax and weak editor support for string templates, which are limitations rather than contradictions. missing for 10: first-party docs showing markup, logic and styles co-located in one component file, any evidence of component styles, and current (non-Angular-2-era) hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write markup and rendering logic together in a single component using markup, styles, and a language I already know

citations.quote: Angular is a development platform for building mobile and desktop web applications using TypeScript/JavaScript and other languages.
organized yet modular thanks to Angular components and dependency injection
HTML template directives (ngFor, ngIf) that designers can work with
